reviewNotes: Sandy's complete makeover sequence and every rotating villager shop greeting are translated directly from English. Each villager's tone and sales pitch, the old-clothes inventory result, egg prices and dialogue controls are preserved. Player-facing wording avoids grammatical gender assumptions.

MakeOver_Sandy_1.preservationReason: The line is a silent dramatic pause consisting only of punctuation and must remain unchanged.

MakeOver_Sandy_3.source: Knock, knock, honey! I'm coming in!

MakeOver_Sandy_6.source: That was fun!$h#$b#I hope you're as happy with your new look as I am!$h
MakeOver_Sandy_6.translation: A fost distractiv!$h#$b#Sper să-ți placă noua înfățișare la fel de mult cum îmi place mie!$h

MakeOver_Sandy_Done.source: You're looking radiant!#$b#I've put your old clothes in your backpack in case you have a change of heart.$h
MakeOver_Sandy_Done.translation: Radiezi!#$b#Ți-am pus hainele vechi în rucsac, în caz că te răzgândești.$h

Shop_Abigail.source: Hey, I grabbed some random stuff out of my closet. Want any of it?
Shop_Abigail.translation: Hei, am luat la întâmplare câteva lucruri din dulap. Vrei ceva de aici?

Shop_Emily.source: Ah, it feels good here in the shade.
Shop_Emily.translation: Ah, ce bine este aici, la umbră.

Shop_Leah.source: I had some extra wood, so I made these mini bookcases...
Shop_Leah.translation: Îmi rămăsese niște lemn, așa că am făcut bibliotecile astea în miniatură...

Shop_Harvey.source: Oh, um... these are some model planes I built... do you like them?
Shop_Harvey.translation: Ah, ăă... acestea sunt niște machete de avioane pe care le-am construit... îți plac?

Shop_Pierre.source: Psst... I'm selling eggs for cash! Hehe... Don't tell Lewis.
Shop_Pierre.translation: Psst... vând ouă pe bani! He-he... Să nu-i spui lui Lewis.

Shop_Sam.source: Want my old broken skateboard? I guess you could use it for decoration or something.
Shop_Sam.translation: Vrei skateboardul meu vechi și stricat? Presupun că l-ai putea folosi ca decorațiune sau ceva de genul ăsta.

Shop_Sebastian.source: I found some stuff by the lake.
Shop_Sebastian.translation: Am găsit niște lucruri lângă lac.

Shop_Caroline.source: Hello. I hope you see something you like.
Shop_Caroline.translation: Bună. Sper să găsești ceva care-ți place.

Shop_Gus.source: In the mood for something delicious?

Shop_Elliott.source: Some interesting things washed up on the beach. Care to trade?
Shop_Elliott.translation: Valurile au adus pe plajă câteva lucruri interesante. Vrei să facem schimb?

Shop_Haley.source: You'd better go find more eggs so you can buy all my stuff!
Shop_Haley.translation: Mai bine mergi să găsești mai multe ouă, ca să-mi poți cumpăra toate lucrurile!

Shop_Demetrius.source: Do you have any eggs to trade? I'm studying the composition of the shell.
Shop_Demetrius.translation: Ai ouă de dat la schimb? Studiez compoziția cojii.

Shop_Robin.source: Hey, check out this custom wallpaper I made. Want it?
Shop_Robin.translation: Hei, uită-te la tapetul acesta făcut de mine. Îl vrei?

Shop_Pam.source: Hehehe... Found some old beverages in the back of the fridge.
Shop_Pam.translation: He-he-he... Am găsit niște băuturi vechi în spatele frigiderului.

Shop_Penny.source: Hi! I hope you find something you like.
Shop_Penny.translation: Bună! Sper să găsești ceva care-ți place.

Shop_Leo.source: Can I have some eggs? I want to put them in my nest.
Shop_Leo.translation: Pot să primesc niște ouă? Vreau să le pun în cuibul meu.

Shop_Evelyn.source: Hello dear. Please take your time, I'll be here all day!
Shop_Evelyn.translation: Bună, dragă. Nu te grăbi, voi fi aici toată ziua!

Shop_Marnie.source: I found an extra roll of wallpaper from my house. It's yours for 20 eggs!
Shop_Marnie.translation: Am găsit acasă o rolă de tapet în plus. Este a ta pentru 20 de ouă!

Shop_Shane.source: Found some food in the freezer. It's yours for cheap. Just don't look at the expiration date.
Shop_Shane.translation: Am găsit niște mâncare în congelator. Ți-o dau ieftin. Doar să nu te uiți la data expirării.

Shop_Jodi.source: I'm sorry, my selection isn't very good this year...
Shop_Jodi.translation: Îmi pare rău, oferta mea nu este prea bună anul acesta...

Shop_Vincent.source: Hi! Um... I found some stuff. Wanna buy it!?
Shop_Vincent.translation: Bună! Ăă... am găsit niște lucruri. Vrei să le cumperi!?

Shop_Kent.source: Hey, I've got a few things for sale. Let me know if anything catches your eye.
Shop_Kent.translation: Salut, am câteva lucruri de vânzare. Spune-mi dacă îți atrage ceva atenția.
